fields.title: Decimal separator
fields.description: Choose a decimal separator, which is used to mark the boundary between the integral and the  fractional parts of the decimal string.

fields.title: Thousands separator
fields.description: Choose a thousands separator used in the decimal string to group together three digits.

fields.title: Type
fields.description: Choose the DataType that your string should be converted to.

fields.title: Accept type suffix, e.g. 'd', 'D', 'f', 'F'
fields.description: When checked, the type suffix will be accepted, otherwise it fails to parse input like <tt>1d</tt>. These suffixes are typically used in java-style programs to represent floating point numbers ('f' for float and 'd' for double). Default is not checked.

fields.title: Fail on error
fields.description: When checked, the node will fail if an error occurs.

fields.title: Column selection
fields.description: Move the columns of interest into the "Includes" list
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица
